verses.1: I saw my altar standing on the altar itself. It said, “Now the horns will be broken, and all those who are powerful will be destroyed. They will be destroyed completely.” There will be no miracles for them, and no saviors for them.
verses.2: If they descend from there, my hands will be seized. And if the heavens rise from there, they will also be destroyed.
verses.3: And if they are caught at the head of the valley from there, I will find them and take them away. And if they hide from my eyes in the land by the sea from there, then I will command the serpent to bite them.
verses.4: And if they go out to battle before their enemies from there, then I will command the destruction and death of them. I have set my eyes on them for evil, not for good.
verses.5: And the armies of Jehovah, those who were stationed on the earth, became silent and mourned. All the inhabitants of that land also mourned. It was like day when everything became dark, and it sank into darkness just like Egypt.
verses.6: The one who builds in the heavens raises his hands, and his commands are carried out upon the earth. The Lord makes them fall upon the face of the earth.
verses.7: Behold, I have made you holy, children of Israel. May the LORD bless you! I have brought you out of Egypt, from the land of slavery. The Philistines and Aram are now under your control.
verses.8: Look, the eyes of Jehovah are upon this wicked kingdom. I have destroyed it from above the earth. For it did not destroy the house of Jacob, says Jehovah.
verses.9: For behold, I am commanding and directing all the nations to take away the houses of Israel, so that they may not be destroyed.
verses.10: In that day, all the sins of my people will be forgiven. Those who say “Do not do this” and “Do not do that” will be forgiven on our behalf.
verses.11: On that day, I will build the tomb of David’s body. I will also repair its foundations and destroy its ruins. Then I will build it anew for all eternity.
verses.12: That they may inherit the rest of Adam’s descendants, and all the nations whose names I have given them. May the LORD do this.
verses.13: See, days are coming, says the LORD. He will go and gather the crops from the fields, and he will walk among the vines. The mountains will be full of fruit, and all the gardens will be ripe with crops.
verses.14: And I restored the rest of my people, Israel. They built cities and settled there. They planted trees and vineyards. They ate their fruits, and they cultivated their fields.
verses.15: And they shall plant them on their land, and they shall not be removed from their land again. For this is what the LORD your God has commanded them to do.
